intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} programmes in {{cityA}}. This page compares recorded year fees, recent placements and ranks from our table, with official sites opened in {{year}}.

IBS Hyderabad vs IPE Hyderabad is a private Hyderabad management comparison. Do not add IPE's itemised heads into a total we have not confirmed, and do not treat IBS executive rows as the flagship MBA.

sections.heading: Icfai Business vs IPE Hyderabad for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose IBS Hyderabad if you want an IBSAT and NMAT listed MBA, with recorded year tuition of ₹8.01 lakh, a 2024 finance row of ₹10 lakh average and ₹21 lakh highest, and a NIRF 2025 Management rank of 46.

Choose IPE if you want a CAT, XAT and ATMA listed PGDM, with recorded year tuition of ₹2.90 lakh plus other itemised heads, and a 2024 banking row of ₹7 lakh average and ₹25 lakh highest, after official confirmation.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For IBS Hyderabad we hold year tuition of ₹8.01 lakh on MBA Finance, Marketing, Human Resources, Operations and Information Technology. That is a year figure, not a confirmed official two-year total, and we have not multiplied it.
For IPE we hold year tuition of ₹2.90 lakh on several PGDM rows, plus separate year heads of ₹50,000 admission fee, ₹15,000 library fee and ₹85,000 other charges.

Do not quote IPE's admission, library or other heads as the programme fee, and do not add them into a total we have not confirmed officially. Confirm the current notices on ibsindia.org and ipeindia.org.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: IBS Hyderabad has a 2024 MBA Finance row of ₹10 lakh average and ₹21 lakh highest, after a 2023 finance row with the same average and highest.

A 2022 IBS finance highest of ₹53 lakh is also stored. Ask for the official report if you need that year's context. An Executive MBA 2020 row is in the table too; do not treat that executive programme as the flagship MBA.
IPE has a 2024 PGDM Banking row of ₹7 lakh average and ₹25 lakh highest. Older 2015 and 2010 rows are stored; do not treat those years as current.
IPE also lists executive PGDM and executive MBA programmes. Do not mix those with the flagship PGDM.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: IBS Hyderabad is listed with IBSAT and NMAT. IPE is listed with ATMA, CAT and XAT. Confirm each school's current official admission note.

On our records, IBS Hyderabad has a NIRF 2025 Management rank of 46, after 39 in 2024, and a Times 2024 rank of 6. IPE has a Times 2024 rank of 83 and a NIRF 2023 rank of 111, with no 2025 NIRF row here.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are private institutes recorded in Hyderabad, Telangana, so a local student can visit them on the same trip.
IBS Hyderabad is listed with MBA specialisations. IPE is listed with several PGDM streams, including banking, general management and healthcare. Match the exact programme.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick IBS Hyderabad if the NIRF 2025 rank of 46 and the 2024 MBA finance placement row matter more, after you confirm the official tuition rather than multiplying our year row.
Pick IPE if a PGDM at that campus fits you, after you have an official fee total rather than a sum of itemised heads, and after you have read the 2024 banking report.
Do not use the IBS executive 2020 row, and do not use IPE's pre-2020 rows.

faqs.question: What MBA or PGDM fees are on record?
faqs.answer: IBS Hyderabad has year tuition of ₹8.01 lakh on several MBA rows, which we have not multiplied. IPE has year tuition of ₹2.90 lakh plus separate admission, library and other heads, which we have not added into a total. Confirm official notices.

faqs.question: How do 2024 placements compare?
faqs.answer: IBS Hyderabad has a 2024 MBA finance row of ₹10 lakh average and ₹21 lakh highest. IPE has a 2024 PGDM banking row of ₹7 lakh average and ₹25 lakh highest. Ask both campuses for the official report.

faqs.question: Which college has the better NIRF Management rank?
faqs.answer: IBS Hyderabad is ranked 46 in 2025 on our records. IPE has a NIRF 2023 rank of 111 and no 2025 NIRF row here. Confirm the official NIRF Management list.

faqs.question: Which exams are listed?
faqs.answer: IBS Hyderabad is listed with IBSAT and NMAT. IPE is listed with ATMA, CAT and XAT. Confirm each school's current official admission note.

faqs.question: Are both campuses in Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are private institutes recorded in Hyderabad, Telangana.

faqs.question: Should I add IPE's itemised fee heads?
faqs.answer: No. Admission, library and other heads are stored separately from tuition. Use the official IPE notice for the full payable fee.
